title: Implement a Python 3.13.5 FastAPI 0.115.6 backend for a random-number-generator application. It shall expose one unauthe
report: Verified the implementation and tests: app/random_service.py provides a parameterless random.random()-based float generator; app/schemas.py defines the sole required number: float field; and app/main.py exposes public POST /generate with the GeneratedNumber response model and one service invocation. Both required unittest modules exist and cover type/bounds plus the in-process API contract. requirements.txt pins FastAPI 0.115.6 and includes Uvicorn. No database, authentication, persistence, messaging, or frontend code was found. The harness log records a successful dependency installation and unittest execution with 2 tests run and OK, plus a successful live Uvicorn POST /generate returning HTTP 200 and an in-range JSON number. tests-artifacts/api_test_report.xlsx exists; its recorded/validated row has the required report columns and a real POST /generate response with status 200 and PASS.
